text: A Study on the Governance of Infringement in Generative AI Images Based on Blockchain-Based Evidence Preservation presents the following source proposition: By providing tamper-proof hash-based evidence at every stage, blockchain technology offers evidential support for the ’access’ requirement, though it cannot replace the determination of algorithmic causation. This proposition is pertinent to Kaal's source-bound claim that Blockchain-based funds can invert the traditional secrecy of hedge funds: the LendingRobot ledger discloses detailed holdings and supplies a hash code signature evidencing that the data is tamper proof. The proposed response is an agreement: the relationship should remain limited to the retrieved source proposition and the mapped Kaal claim unless fuller source review supports a broader conclusion.
